title: Mac Studio Is Here. Its Base Price Still Isn't.

items.claim: Apple debuted M5 Ultra in the new Mac Studio.
items.note: The official excerpt explicitly says Apple debuted M5 Ultra in the new Mac Studio.

items.claim: The available official excerpt does not confirm an M5 Max Mac Studio configuration or a base-price number.
items.note: Neither M5 Max nor pricing appears in the supplied official excerpt; this is a correctly framed absence statement.

items.claim: Ars Technica said the refresh keeps daisy-chained Macs for AI in view.
items.note: This matches the supplied Ars Technica excerpt.

items.claim: A TestingCatalog social post linked the desktop refresh with M6 and M5 Ultra chips.
items.note: The supplied post announces M6 and M5 Ultra alongside the new Mac Studio and Mac mini.

items.claim: A second-hand Chinese report circulated mainland-China starting prices for M5 Max and M5 Ultra Mac Studio versions.
items.note: The supplied Zhihu excerpt reports M5 Max and M5 Ultra Mac Studio variants with starting prices of RMB 19,999 and RMB 46,999. The article correctly labels it second-hand and not independently reviewed.

items.claim: Apple is positioning its desktop silicon closer to local AI work.
items.note: This is a clearly signposted strategic inference supported by Apple's AI-compute framing and Ars Technica's local-AI characterization, not presented as a precise product fact.

items.claim: The evidence cannot certify the M5 Max base price, market-specific price movement, or the precise configuration behind the forwarded claim.
items.note: Correctly limited to the available evidence: no official store or configuration source is provided.

claim_check.reason: The article’s event-specific factual claims match the supplied excerpts. Its key negative conclusions are properly phrased as limits of the available evidence, and its broader commercial and local-AI observations are framed as inference or background rather than asserted as independently established launch facts.

evidence_caveats: 当前材料不能确认任何 Mac Studio 基础售价、价格变化或 M5 Max 具体配置。
M5 Max 与 M5 Ultra 的型号冲突尚未通过官方产品页或其他一手页面消解。
独立媒体仅能交叉确认新 Mac Studio 发布，未在现有摘录中独立确认芯片型号或价格。
seo_title: Mac Studio Is Here. Its Base Price Still Isn't.
seo_summary: Apple confirms the new Mac Studio with M5 Ultra—but not the circulated M5 Max configuration or base price buyers need.
